sens_en: to owe, to yawn, to lack
origine_fr: Un homme à genoux, la bouche grande ouverte : il bâille. On le dessinait déjà ainsi il y a plus de 3 000 ans. Dans d'autres caractères, il marque la bouche ouverte, pour souffler, chanter ou boire, comme dans 欢.
origine_en: A kneeling man with his mouth wide open: he is yawning. It was already drawn this way more than 3,000 years ago. In other characters, it marks the open mouth, for blowing, singing or drinking, as in 欢.
